1609_2024.decisive_evidence: The UY2021 gross ultimate loss ratio stated in the narrative: 49.6% at end-2023 (2023 p5) and 36.2% at end-2024 (2024 p6). Only the alternating reading (2022 as labelled, 2023 transposed, 2024 as labelled) gives UY2021 a level (66.7m at end-23 -> implied premium 134.5m >= calendar-2021 GWP 111.9m) and a direction (66,053 -> 54,930, down) that agree with those statements. The other consistent chain (2023 as labelled, 2024 transposed) gives UY2021 44,451 at end-23 (GULR <= 39.7% on GWP >= 111.9m) rising to 57,359 at end-24 while the stated GULR fell.
1609_2024.caveat: Implied UY2021 gross premium under the adopted reading is 134.5m (end-23) vs 151.7m (end-24, 54,930/0.362): not exact, so the denominators of the two GULR statements may differ; the direction test does not depend on that.
